services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: Climb into a cockpit and explore beyond our skies through immersive flight simulation and astronomy experiences at the Museum of Aviation. Flight Simulation challenges participants to take command of their own flight mission, building leadership, adaptability, and confidence, while the Astronomy Planetarium brings the solar system and universe to life through engaging, hands-on discovery. The 3-hour Mission Quest program involves planning and flying a mission. Mission success depends on working together as a team for mutual support.
